result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it narrows Licensee’s indemnity to Licensee-provided content/data and legal violations, adds Licensor indemnities for third-party IP claims, legal violations, Licensor-caused data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, and includes standard claims procedures. The notwithstanding language appropriately prevents the existing IP exclusion and liability cap from defeating Licensor’s indemnity. The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated terms. Drafting quality is reduced by duplicate subsection numbering in Article XIII, awkward placement of the indemnity provisions within the limitation-of-liability article, the typo “API’s,” and some ambiguity as to whether the procedural provision applies equally to both parties’ indemnities.
